title: Axeloz Filesharing before 2.14.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users…
description: Axeloz Filesharing versions prior to 2.14.3 have a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject malicious scripts via raw HTML or javascript: Markdown links in bundle descriptions. When recipients view the public bundle preview page, the injected script executes through Alpine x-html, enabling attackers to steal the owner's token from localStorage and perform owner-scoped actions on victim bundles.
